description: SR-PPO-DLS residual action + seed-projection lock (PDF sections 6.5-6.6, eq. 35-39).

projection.formula: q_proj_j = clip(q_cand_j, q_j_min + delta_j, q_j_max - delta_j)
projection.margin_delta_policy: per-joint, range-relative (not one shared radian value across all joints)
projection.margin_values: dev-tuned in a later phase, not fixed in Phase 1
